invariants.rationale: The method returns either a singleton iterator or a new JavaLazyInsertIterable, neither can be null.
idPfx is passed as a method parameter and is used in constructor; it is expected to be non-null.
recordItr is passed as a parameter and used in several places; null values would lead to an exception.
If recordItr has next, result is a JavaLazyInsertIterable; otherwise, it's a singleton iterator.
If there are no records, result yields a single empty list.
